title: Fenerbahçe x Besiktas: What to Expect from Friday's Derby
subtitle: A Matchup Promising Goals and Historic Rivalry
excerpt: Friday's derby between Fenerbahçe and Besiktas promises to be a goal-filled duel
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
This Friday, Fenerbahçe's stadium will host a classic that promises to be full of goals. The duel against Besiktas, broadcast live by beIN SPORTS, brings together two teams that have scored 14 goals in six games this season.

New Reinforcements in Fenerbahçe's Front Line

Fenerbahçe completed the summer transfer window with the arrival of Mason Greenwood and Romelu Lukaku. The combination of these strikers forms the club's new front line, seeking to strengthen the attack in search of positive results.

Offensive Quality of Both Teams

Both sides have already scored 14 goals in six games, demonstrating a high offensive standard. Fenerbahçe and Besiktas have won two games and lost one, placing them in third and fourth place in the table, respectively.

Besiktas' Goal Difference Advantage

Besiktas has a slight advantage in goal difference. However, six of the seven goals scored by the club this season were against newly promoted Çorum, in which Dušan Vlahović scored a hat-trick.

A Classic with Goal-Scoring Potential

The duel promises to be a classic and full of goals. Fenerbahçe will have Trossard alongside Vlahović, while Besiktas brings its attacking line to the matchup. The expectation is for an exciting game with chances for both sides.

Live Broadcast on beIN SPORTS

The game will be broadcast live on beIN SPORTS, allowing football fans to follow the classic in real-time. beIN SPORTS guarantees comprehensive coverage of the derby, with commentary and analysis during the match.
